window_counts_and_rule.labelling_rule: A window of 10 contiguous traffic flows is labelled 1 (attack) if at least one constituent flow is an attack (y_i == 1), and 0 (benign) if and only if all 10 flows are benign (y_i == 0). Because blocks in preprocessing were sampled per contiguous attack/benign episode, mixed windows are 0 across all splits.

threshold_search_analysis.candidate_grid_spec: Candidate decision thresholds derived directly from roc_curve(y_val, y_probs) across [0.0, 1.0]
threshold_search_analysis.capping_rule: Uncapped (the former min(max(t, 0.01), 0.99) cap was removed; thresholds are optimized strictly by FPR <= 1%)

block_bootstrap_cis.window_overlap_caveat: Windows are constructed with sequence length 10 and step size 5, meaning adjacent windows share 50% of their constituent traffic flows. Furthermore, traffic within an attack episode is heavily auto-correlated. As a consequence, observations are not independent trials, reducing the effective sample size Neff < N. Standard Wilson score intervals treat all N observations as independent, which understates true uncertainty. Block bootstrap resampling over contiguous blocks of windows directly preserves temporal autocorrelation and empirically estimates realistic confidence bands.
